适用.notes: Written and legal, with a rule or a law as the subject: 适用于+X · 适用范围 scope · 同样适用 · 本条不适用 · 适用法律. You 应用 a method to a task; a rule 适用于 a case — 适用 has no agent. 使用 = use a thing; 适合 = suit someone.

应用.notes: 应用于 · 应用到实际中 · 广泛应用 · 应用题 word problem · 应用程序 app. You 应用 a method or a technology to a task, so it has an agent; a rule 适用于 a case and has none. Applying for a job or school is 申请, never 应用. Mnemo: 应 (adapt) + 用 (use) → to adapt for use; to apply.

通用.notes: Works everywhere without change: 通用充电器 · 通用语言 · 通用标准 · 全国通用 · 通用性. An adjective, so it takes 是…的 and no object, where 适用 is a verb taking 于. Mnemo: 通 (through) + 用 (use) → usable right through.
